plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Transfer Pathway map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The program has THREE pathways, each printed at 60-65 units, 4 terms. This plan transcribes the first/default pathway, to CSU Bakersfield Communications - Journalism Bachelor of Arts, Bakersfield College portion ONLY (Terms 1-4). The same page's CSU Bakersfield continuation (60 units) is a different institution's degree and is excluded. The other two pathways (CSU Bakersfield Communications - Public Relations, and a generic 'to CSU' pattern) are further patterns for the same credential, not separate degrees, and are not collected as separate plans. The transcribed map prints the Bakersfield College degree total as a range, 60-65 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-16.5 / 15-16 / 15-16. Ranged rows: 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5) in Term 1, 'Area 2 : Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning' (3-4.5) in Term 2, 'Area 3B : Humanities' (3-4) in Term 3, and 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4) in Term 4. Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. The Term 1 'Oral Communication Course' and Term 2 'Critical Thinking Course' slots are each printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed' and are recorded as major choice slots. Term 2 prints two identical 'Major List A' rows; both are recorded as separate choice slots exactly as printed. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. No row on the Bakersfield College portion shows a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
